blocked_on: a decision log (content_id | decision | date | reason). Every Tier-1 trigger except the base rate needs it, and it is the only route to a causal claim.

label_base_rate.why: every precision figure is quoted against this

label_definition.trigger: ANY change to the threshold -> immediate refit
label_definition.why: ML-09 found the research paper documenting this same field as +/-10%

new_client.reference: measured cost of an unseen client = 0.152 AUC
new_client.trigger: any client onboarded -> withhold queue until history exists
new_client.why: an unseen client gets the model's weakest output

per_client_auc_min.trigger: any client >=200 pages below 0.55 -> withhold that queue

precision_at_50.why: 0.70 is the ML-03 usefulness floor, committed before building

queue_concentration.trigger: largest client > 0.40 of the SENDABLE set (i.e. the cap stopped working)
queue_concentration.why: the raw ranking concentrates at 0.58; the cap is the only thing holding it down

top_feature.trigger: a different feature takes the top slot
top_feature.why: the ranking's basis changed; re-read the error analysis

sendable.note: a product decision layered on the ranking - NOT model performance
